scope: new independent source-only mechanical intervention-choice comparison; no native model
hypothesis: Choosing a one-bit do intervention by expected information gain about retained operator identity improves cold transfer and incompatible-memory rejection over an identically informed two-slot Bayesian model that chooses actions by predictive entropy, under an identical action budget and update/prediction rule. This tests a new action-selection mechanism, not a post-hoc adjustment of AAI-12U confidence.

world.primitive: A hidden 8-bit table mask applied to three public port bits, XOR fourth public port input; ports fixed by phase and public
world.source_sampling: Public donor and interference phase expose one paired fourth-port do for each ternary code 0..7, using 4 nuisance dimensions with a SHA256('AAI12V|fixture|group|phase|code') modulo 8 nuisance context. Receiver initially exposes two distinct codes chosen by ascending SHA256('AAI12V|fixture|group|receiver_code|code') digest; then ONE additional pair for an unobserved code 0..7 selected by each arm's frozen policy. All training/probe nuisance contexts are 0..7. For evaluation all 8 codes x nuisance contexts 8..15 x fourth port 0 and 1 =128 heldout inputs per group fixture. Heldout context range excludes every source training/probe input for every arm.
world.outputs: Always public x[8], y bit, public phase port tuple and witnessed actual one-bit-do transition marker, never private mask/group class/heldout labels.

model.shared_prior: Three latent models: donor memory, interference memory, unconstrained unknown primitive. Prior weights [0.45,0.45,0.10]; likelihood of each receiver public code outcome is 0.95 for a matching remembered mask bit, 0.05 for mismatch, and 0.5 for unknown. Duplicate fourth-port public observations form one independent ternary-code evidence item. All arms use exact same update rule and posterior predictive mixture after action; observed code outputs override with public truth. Unknown predictions are 0.5.
model.candidate: For each unobserved ternary code select one whose true prospective do outcome maximizes the expected reduction in Shannon entropy of the 3-latent-hypothesis posterior (expectation over predicted bit); tie-break smallest code. Model cannot see actual outcome before selecting.
model.matched_best_control: For each unobserved ternary code select the one with maximum predictive binary outcome entropy under exactly the same posterior and candidate likelihood; tie-break smallest code. Full equal-data, equal-memory, equal-actions Bayesian entropy-greedy control.

other_controls.random_probe: Hash SHA256('AAI12V|fixture|group|RANDOM') modulo six remaining codes, sorted
other_controls.sham_probe: a real do intervention on already observed first code, no additional ternary code coverage; identical number of do actions but intentionally less information

model.memory: Exactly two learned 8-bit primitive tables plus public observed ternary codes, no cross-group oracle; canonical cold checkpoint after probe, restored before predicting heldout source. The model sees input port mapping but not target hidden mask; no pretrained donor or next-token training.

gates.stop: Single source-only screen. On any miss => DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE; no tuner, no new masks/seeds, no after-outcome policy edits, no science first-use or full control rerun.
gates.invalid: Any hidden-field exposure, mismatched action budget, test/train nuisance overlap, data selection based on measured results, source SHA mismatch, or impl errors invalidates score rather than counting as scientific negative.
